title: Indian Polity — M. Laxmikanth
detail: The single most important book on this list. Start it in Phase 0.

title: NCERT Geography, Class 11 & 12
detail: Fundamentals of Physical Geography, India Physical Environment, Human Geography, India People & Economy

title: Certificate Physical and Human Geography — G.C. Leong
detail: Your NCERTs are thin on climatology, and 2024–25 leaned hard on it

title: A Brief History of Modern India — Spectrum
detail: Rajiv Ahir. The standard, and rightly so

title: Environment — Shankar IAS
detail: Or PMF IAS. Pick one, never both

title: Indian Art and Culture — Nitin Singhania
detail: Faster to revise than the Fine Arts NCERT, which matters by pass four

title: Oxford Student Atlas for India
detail: Open on the desk during every Geography and Environment session

title: NCERT Class 11 — Indian Economic Development
detail: Free PDF at ncert.nic.in, but a physical copy is worth it

title: NCERT Class 12 Political Science — both books
detail: Contemporary World Politics carries 10+ questions a year on its own

title: Tamil Nadu Class 11 History
detail: Ancient and medieval, better written than the old NCERTs

title: Mrunal Patel — Pillars handouts
detail: Economy. Free, and better than most paid economy material

title: A CSAT manual
detail: Disha or Arihant. One book, worked through twice, is enough

title: NCERT Class 11–12 Biology — ecology chapters only
detail: Chapters 13–16 of Class 12. Free PDF

title: Sociology: Themes and Perspectives — Haralambos & Holborn
detail: Paper 1 backbone. Read it like a novel the first time

title: IGNOU BA/MA Sociology material
detail: Free downloads. Genuinely the best value on this entire page

title: Social Change in Modern India — M.N. Srinivas
detail: Paper 2. Short, foundational, quotable in answers

title: Indian Society: Themes and Social Issues — Nadeem Hasnain
detail: Paper 2 workhorse. Doubles as GS-1 society

title: Sociological Theory — George Ritzer
detail: Reference only. Do not read cover to cover

title: Vision IAS PT365 compilations
detail: All of them. Science & Tech, Environment, Economy, Polity, Schemes

title: Prelims test series — Forum IAS
detail: ~₹4,500, moderate difficulty, strong current-affairs tests, good value. Vision IAS at ~₹6,500 is closer to the real paper if the budget stretches

title: Free supplementary tests
detail: Insights and CivilsDaily daily quizzes — use from October, no reason to pay before February
